title: Builders Program - New Updates and Roadmap
body:
Hello Everyone, I am posting on this forum after a long time. This is not a proposal. I just want to post something about what I'm doing for Edgeware now. Let's take this as a small roadmap too.

Here is the current status of my funded projects:

**Block Explorer: **Hybrid Explorer is 75% finished; the smart contract verification process is pending. I will complete this once we get more transactions. Only a few people use the EVM side, and that's bad. Kabocha and Soupcan Explorers are offline for now. Currently, Mainnet and Beresheet EVM Explorers are online.

**Android Wallet:** The first version of the wallet is in the Play Store and is running without any bugs. First, I thought I could upgrade this wallet by adding some functions, but now I have different plans. You can read about it in the "New Plans" section below.

**Browser Wallet:** The Browser Wallet extension is in the Firefox web store. Google Chrome and other browsers are forcing Manifest V3. It's a big task to do it later, once all the priority tasks are done.

**iOS wallet: **Submitted to the Apple Store, but it's in "pending" status. They want me to remove the embedded Dapps browser. Like the Android app, I have a different plan for this.

**IDO launchpad:** I tried my best to design a unique IDO launchpad and gave this project to a development team. It's 95% complete. I will write a separate thread on this once it's ready. It was in the first funding request. The average rate for the funding was 0.00342, but I had to use this to fill the rate of my third proposal. As we are using a development firm for full functionality, it's around $25/hour and 250+ hours spent on this. It's already over the budget; I need at least 70% of the budget as a top-up with a higher reference price (0.001), that will be used for liquidity in DEX and Bridge. I won't sell any tokens from now on. I prefer to hold EDG. I couldn't hold EDG from my last proposal because I must use USDT for my work.

**EVM Tools: **I delivered DE
